# Native CLI captures

Captured from installed OpenCode 1.19.5 and official DeepSeek Harness 0.2.2-rc.1
using Node 24.16.0 and a deterministic loopback model fixture on 2026-11-17.
Paths, native IDs and timestamps were normalized; message/tool/outcome envelopes
were retained. These are real CLI transport captures, not real-model acceptance.
